method: Use unique no-backup directories and unique Keystore aliases with production HistoryStore and LogicalArchive; no live singleton.
Set max_page_count to current page_count and read back on the same confined writer as the nested archive call.
Require SQLite FULL failure diagnostic/type; reject unrelated errors and require archive callbacks before failure.
Compare canonical rows from every persisted application table including FactOrigin and StoreMetadata immediately and after close/reopen.
Raise the page cap, retry each path, compare imported rows with independently staged rows; reopen and compare full committed snapshot.
Source and validated stores remain unchanged.

implementation.sourceHashScope: sourceSha256: working-tree build inputs; repositoryLfSourceSha256: Git LF-normalized bytes.

limits: Real engine page-limit failure, not filesystem ENOSPC, filled phone storage, temporary/WAL volume exhaustion, preflight reserve or provider write failure.
No process kill/power loss, migration, maximum history/resource benchmark, minimum API, coordinator/UI error mapping or concurrent ingestion qualification.
Two declared synthetic database-growth failures, not every record/page/commit boundary.
No production behavior/capability promotion/release clearance or source playback reliability improvement; seven-day baseline unstarted; emulator deferred.

references.supports: Database page cap and read-back semantics; cap cannot fall below current size.
SQLITE_FULL is primary result 13; an engine failure does not establish actual device-volume exhaustion.

next: Isolated process interruption/owner recovery or protection/lifecycle/accessibility work; actual ENOSPC and coordinator/UI delivery remain open. Source research needs a different source-qualified hypothesis.
